summary: Glaze Writer on Canvas: assignment text boxes (classic and Assignments 2), discussion and announcement replies, the Inbox and classic quiz essays open in Writer, in your Look. Submit, Reply and Send wait until Canvas holds exactly what you wrote. Settings → Writer → Glaze Writer turns it off. New Quizzes is not covered. Writer on Canvas keeps what you write on this device and offers it back when a box opens empty. Writer's AI on Canvas reads the assignment's instructions, or the post you are replying to. Nothing is read on a quiz or in the Inbox. Blackboard's Activity cards say whether each assignment is submitted, late, graded or missing. Canvas pages float on your Look's panels, as Blackboard's do. Sync to Google Drive merges To Do, class schedules, GPA terms, dashboard notes, Looks history, favorites, the dictionary and saved sources item by item when two devices changed them. Agents reconnect by themselves after the browser restarts, and glaze-mcp setup picks a safe Node.js or says it isn't set up. Ask Rime saves a memory only from your own words, and its answers link only to your school's site or to addresses Glaze read for that answer. AI suggests grammar and word-choice changes in Writer instead of making them as you type. Autocorrect sends a cloud model only the sentence and its candidate fixes. A spreadsheet cell using a function Glaze can't calculate keeps the file's own value. Documents holds at most 2,000 documents. A shared Look with while or do shader loops, or a picture on your own network, is refused. A dark Look prints as dark ink on white. Settings, the popup and the hub are readable in Windows High Contrast. Canvas: hovering no longer flashes white, and Assignments 2's lines and the upload box's "or" divider take your Look's colours. Writer: Find and Replace with hyphenated words, fixes beside a footnote or picture, autocorrect in other languages, reference formatting and exports. Sheets and slides: damaged workbooks open, and large decks open faster. Grades and GPA rounding, To Do ticks and reminders, Notes titles and drops, and syllabus week starts in your school's time zone. On a shared browser profile, Canvas's course cards and Blackboard's navigation are kept per student. Search skips folders a cut-short read never reached. Moodle drops courses you've left. Look animations go off on a quiz opened inside Blackboard in Firefox before 147. AI setup shows Connected only once site access is granted, and Your key turns AI on only once a key works. Study help lists every Blackboard to-do item. Blackboard: a dropdown in a test question opens on top of the questions below it. Agents on Blackboard get a fresh planner. Settings: / opens search again with a switch focused, and Clear all papers and documents also removes spreadsheets, PDFs and slide decks. Selected rows, chips, field edges and the To Do count are easier to read in the light Looks.
